name: temperature_table
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module temperature_table
  purpose: Print a Celsius to Fahrenheit conversion table.

import std.console

public function to_fahrenheit(celsius: Decimal) returns Decimal
  purpose: Convert a Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit.
  example: to_fahrenheit(0) is 32
  example: to_fahrenheit(100) is 212
  example: to_fahrenheit(-40) is -40

  return celsius * 9 / 5 + 32
end

public function main() needs console
  purpose: Print the table from -10 to 40 degrees in steps of 10.

  console.print("Celsius  Fahrenheit")
  for each celsius from -10 to 40 by 10
    let fahrenheit be to_fahrenheit(celsius.to_decimal())
    console.print("{celsius.to_text().pad_left(7)}  {fahrenheit.to_text().pad_left(10)}")
  end
end
